## Findings

### Warning Findings

```
[W-01] strategies/README.md prose may over-promise custom strategy creation
Category: Documentation
Severity: Warning
File: README.md
Lines: 128
Description: The README says "See src/application/strategies/README.md for detailed information about the available strategies." However, src/application/strategies/README.md describes the strategy system and directory structure but does not currently document how to create custom strategies (the old text said "creating custom strategies"). The linked file does not contain a "Creating a new strategy" or "Custom strategy" section, so a reader looking for creation guidance will not find it.
Suggestion: Either restore the "creating custom strategies" wording in the README if that documentation exists elsewhere, or add a "Creating a new strategy" section to src/application/strategies/README.md so the link fulfills its promise.
```

### Suggestions

```
[S-01] Feature list ordering duplicates "Local model inference" concept
Category: Documentation
Severity: Suggestion
File: README.md
Lines: general
Description: The Features list now contains two closely related bullet points near each other: "Multiple Local Model Providers: Works with any OpenAI-compatible server..." and "Local model inference: Works with your own OpenAI-compatible server...". Both describe local/OpenAI-compatible inference. The duplication is minor but adds noise.
Suggestion: Merge into a single bullet or remove the older, less precise one ("Multiple Local Model Providers") since the new "Local model inference" bullet is clearer and more accurate.
```

The PR is safe to merge. All factual updates (Python 3.10+, repository URLs, installation commands, linter command) are correct and verified. The one warning about the strategies README link is minor and does not block merge, but should be addressed in a follow-up to keep documentation honest.
